names.note: AUTHOR assessment: the retained homepage heading uses the full lead name without a hyphen. The About Us history also uses Absentee-Shawnee and explicitly distinguishes the (Loyal) Shawnee and Eastern Shawnee. The alternate hyphenated legal-directory spelling is preserved as an alias. All 472 canonical names, aliases and official hosts were examined; no matching profile was found. This is an identity crosswalk only, not recognition adjudication. The lands field is a broad, source-described community location, not a boundary or title claim.
